title: CapsuleEvidenceBundle
description: The evidence collected against a set of InspectorRequirements for one envelope. Statuses reuse the project-wide CheckStatus, so missing evidence renders as NOT_RUN or UNKNOWN and never collapses into PASS. A pack never writes this: the kernel requests inspectors and records what they answered, which is why a pack cannot turn its own FAIL into a PASS.

envelope_id.description: The envelope this evidence is about. Evidence for a different envelope is wrong-artifact evidence and is refused.

evidence_digest.description: sha256 over the artifact identities and hashes this evidence was produced against. If the artifacts change, the digest stops matching and the evidence is stale - the same staleness mechanism policy acceptances use.

inspector.description: What actually answered, recorded for audit. This is the ONE place a concrete tool name legitimately appears, because it is a fact about the past rather than a decision about the future.

satisfied.description: Every BLOCKING requirement answered PASS. Computed by the kernel from results; a pack cannot assert it.
